# VS Code Quick Open Score

Microsoft VS Code 1.136.2，commit `88e44fa0e00b08f7758b4f6d05632e4fd5e4df6f`，`src/vs/base/common/fuzzyScorer.ts`，MIT license. Retain algorithms and third-party names, redirect only the base module import to the locked Monaco 0.56.0. Caller is workspace_quick_open_matcher.ts; no runtime download.
